# KKGo1999

> Personal website with a stock and options analysis workspace.

## Options

- [Options data guide](https://www.kkgo1999.top/options/agent/llms.txt): Entry points, data scope, units, and reading rules.
- [Readable stock and options directory](https://www.kkgo1999.top/options/agent/): Static stock tables and paginated option chains.
- [Fields and formulas](https://www.kkgo1999.top/options/agent/fields.md): Data interpretation and calculation methodology.
